description: Convene a governed deliberation session for a charter. Each seat (AI model with a specific role) deliberates on the topic according to the charter's mode (parallel/chain/adversarial/roundtable/auto). Returns a session_id — use board_get_session to retrieve the output once complete. Typical runtime: 30–120 seconds depending on seat count and mode.

charter_id.description: Charter ID of the board or committee to convene

context.description: Additional background context, documents, or data to inject into all seat prompts

topic.description: The question, decision, or matter to deliberate on. Be specific — this is what every seat will reason about.

name: board_convene_session
